sections.title: Local remediation, the block in one paragraph

keyTerms.definition: Differentiable dictionary lookup. Softmax turns query-key scores into a distribution, and the output is the expected value.
A one-way mirror. Each position sees itself and the past, never the future.
Rotary position encoding. Rotating queries and keys makes their dot product depend on relative distance.
The gated FFN variant. A Swish branch modulates the up-projected features multiplicatively.
The highway that carries the input to the output. The sub-block only proposes a correction.
Sharing one matrix between the embedding table and the output head, transposed.

recall.question: Why divide attention scores by sqrt(dh)?
recall.answer: Query and key components have roughly unit variance, so dot products grow like dh. The scale keeps the softmax inputs in range.

recall.question: How does pre-norm differ from post-norm?
recall.answer: Pre-norm keeps the residual stream as the identity path end to end and normalizes a copy for each sub-block. Post-norm renormalizes every layer output, which stabilizes activations but puts the norm on the gradient highway.

recall.question: What does the FFN add that attention cannot?
recall.answer: Attention mixes across positions. The FFN transforms each position alone, adding depth-wise capacity and the nonlinearity the network needs.
